fields.Name: T158 - Committees Meeting Record
fields.Description: In the Committees app, open 'Meetings' from the app's navigation (if it is not there, navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Committees:%20Meetings — do not use the sidebar search, because two entities are called 'Meetings'). Type 'Standards Committee — Q4 2015' in the grid's filter box ('Filter records...') and open the meeting 'Standards Committee — Q4 2015 meeting': click its row and then 'Open Full Record', or double-click the row. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,

  ]
}
